e01-ana-excited.observed_description: Ana (sage overshirt, white top, jeans) stands in a bright living room behind a white birthday cake with lit candles, both fists raised, mouth wide open in a delighted smile, looking down at the cake; red, yellow and blue balloons float beside her.
e01-ana-excited.note: Usable: her excitement and the birthday cake both read at 180 px; nobody else is in the photo. Face matches the 1.2 reference.

c05-luis-tshirt.observed_description: Luis stands in a sunny park, seen from the hips up, smiling, in a plain bright-blue short-sleeved T-shirt with a round neck and khaki trousers, arms at his sides.
c05-luis-tshirt.note: Usable: the blue T-shirt is the one clear piece at 180 px; no jacket, shirt buttons, hat or scarf. Face and build match the 1.2 reference.

c06-ana-jeans.observed_description: Ana stands full length on a quiet tree-lined street, smiling, hands in the front pockets of long blue jeans, with a plain white T-shirt tucked in and white sneakers.
c06-ana-jeans.note: Usable: the long blue jeans are visible from waist to ankle and read at 180 px; no skirt, dress, shorts or jacket. She stands right of center; the centered 4:5 crop keeps her whole.

r06-diego-wet.observed_description: Diego stands in heavy rain on a grey city street with no umbrella, seen from the knees up, his hair and burgundy shirt soaked and covered in drops, arms held out from his body, looking down unhappily.
r06-diego-wet.note: Usable: the falling rain and his soaked hair and shirt read at 180 px; no umbrella, hood or coat. Face and beard match the 1.2 reference.

g03-luis-basketball.observed_description: Luis, in a white sleeveless top and navy shorts, jumps on an outdoor court with one arm stretched up to the hoop while the orange basketball sits right on the rim and net above his hand.
g03-luis-basketball.note: Usable: the ball at the hoop and his confident reach read at 250 px as a made shot. The hoop is in the upper left, so the photo stays out of four-picture cards.

g04-ana-piano.observed_description: Ana (sage overshirt) sits at an upright wooden piano in a bright living room, seen from the side, both hands on the keys, smiling calmly at the keys.
g04-ana-piano.note: Usable: playing the piano with ease reads at 250 px. The piano fills the right edge, so the photo stays out of four-picture cards.
